final:
type BadInput = { text: str }

sum_parsed(xs: List[str]) -> int fail BadInput =
  ex sum_parsed([]) == 0
  ex sum_parsed(["1", "2", "3"]) == 6
  ex sum_parsed(["-4", "10"]) == 6
  var t = 0
  for s in xs
    let v = s.parse_int() else fail BadInput(text: copy s)
    t += v
  t
